hook: Only *4.98%* of graduate-voter applications approved. Deadline *Nov 6*
hook_b: *4.96 lakh* graduate-voter forms still pending. Is yours one?
tldr: For the two Graduate MLC seats in Telangana, just 26,085 of about 5.2 lakh voter applications (4.98%) are approved; 4,96,112 (94.72%) await verification and 1,581 were rejected. Enrolment closes Nov 6. In Mahabubnagar–Rangareddy–Hyderabad, only 4,695 of 2,29,937 are approved.

beats.what: 26,085 approved, 4,96,112 pending, 1,581 rejected across Mahabubnagar–Rangareddy–Hyderabad and Warangal–Khammam–Nalgonda.
beats.why: Graduate rolls are made fresh each time; an earlier enrolment doesn't carry over, and many graduates don't know that.
beats.care: Graduated 3+ years ago and live in these districts? Enrol (Form 18) before Nov 6, then check your status. Pending isn't approved.

cards.caption: approved of 2,29,937 in Mahabubnagar–Rangareddy–Hyderabad
cards.body: Hyderabad district has seen very low response, The Hindu reports.
At the current pace, the roll may reach only about 7.7 lakh by the deadline, roughly 74% of the 10.36 lakh electors in 2021.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Graduate MLC polls: nearly five lakh voter applications pending (print, Hyderabad edition, 27 Oct, p.4)
